course_summary:
ISEN 614 | Advanced Quality Control | Fall 2026
Instructor: Jaesung Lee | j.lee@tamu.edu
Meets: TR | 09:35AM-10:50AM | ETB 2026
Grading: Three Exams [65%], In-class Exercise [15%], Homework [10%], Course Project [10%] — A: 90-100, B: 80-89.9, C: 70-79.9, D: 60-69.9, F: Below 59.9
Topics: ARL, T2 Charts, PCA, Data Reduction, Regression-based Risk Adjustment, Attribute Control Charts, Three discrete Distributions, Multivariate Statistics, Statistical Inference, Confidence Interval, Hypothesis Testing, Probability Distributions, linear regression, root cause identification, statistical process control, anomaly detection, change detection, quality control programs, manufacturing quality control, medical error detection, Advanced methods, classical treatments, evaluation, design, maintenance, monitoring, basic data analysis tools, Errors, Control Chart
Tools: Canvas, Statistics Capable (hand-held) Calculator, TI 84 Plus, TI 89, Nspire, Matlab, R, Python, EXCEL, Minitab
Prerequisites: STAT 212 or STAT 601, hypothesis test knowledge, linear regression knowledge, ISEN 350 (or equivalent)
